statement: For every cyclotomic number field K containing the twelfth roots of unity, and every finite-order Hecke character χ of K, the Hecke L-function 44 LK(s, χ) has no zero in ℜs > 1 − δ, δ = 10−6 . The principal character is included, with its pole at s = 1 permitted. There is no restriction on conductor or imaginary part.
